Use case: illustration-story. Create one LANDSCAPE production storyboard sheet with exactly FOUR equal 16:9 panels in a clean 2-by-2 grid, thin white gutters. Each panel is a single cinematic still, not multiple events. Use the attached named character masters as identity references and attached environments as layout references. Preserve faces, ages, clothing and relative heights. Original polished stylized 3D family animation. No speech balloons and no generated dialogue text. Small shot ID labels only at lower-left of each panel. Panels in reading order:
Panel 1, S25: Visible characters LEO, DAN. Medium Leo holding small clear bag of spinach at waist height. Location: MARKET_STALL. Depict ONLY this ending state as a single still: One bag of spinach placed on top; all ten purchased item types selected.. Action context for expressions (do not show multiple stages or duplicate an object in two places): Leo finds the final item on Nina's yellow list. Dan reaches for his pocket, finally separating the colored papers. The still-empty totes hang on the counter hook; Ella remains off-screen.
Panel 2, S26: Visible characters DAN, ELLA. Medium close-up of Dan examining separated lists; Ella right. Location: MARKET_STALL. Depict ONLY this ending state as a single still: Dan recognizes list-purpose reversal; blue and yellow notes separated in hands.. Action context for expressions (do not show multiple stages or duplicate an object in two places): The blue and yellow notes open side by side. Dan reads the colored dish headings, realizes the mismatch, and looks down at the basket. Exact headings added in post.
Panel 3, S27: Visible characters DAN. Medium Dan close-up; market softly behind; phone at right ear. Location: MARKET_STALL. Depict ONLY this ending state as a single still: Phone at Dan's right ear; lists remain on counter.. Action context for expressions (do not show multiple stages or duplicate an object in two places): Dan answers his dark plain smartphone. Maya is heard off-screen from home. Dan looks at the yellow soup list on the counter, still embarrassed by his earlier confusion.
Panel 4, S28: Visible characters DAN. Same medium close-up, slight pause before his reply; no new camera angle. Location: MARKET_STALL. Depict ONLY this ending state as a single still: Phone set face up on counter; call still connected; no readable phone interface required.. Action context for expressions (do not show multiple stages or duplicate an object in two places): Dan asks for clarification. Nina's off-screen voice joins the call from the same home location. He smiles with relief and sets the phone to speaker on the counter.
Keep blue and yellow list papers BLANK for later exact editorial text. Never draw invented food labels or duplicate blue-list contents on yellow paper. Each selected vegetable exists once; if it has been placed in the basket, it is no longer also in a hand or on the counter. Unpurchased crate stock is separate. Exact quantities apply only to selected produce. Use unobtrusive background blur for stock. The source images in order are: LEO, DAN, ELLA, MARKET_STALL. Select ONLY the named cast for each panel; a lineup source does not mean all people appear in every panel. Do not merge people, duplicate a cast member in a panel, change clothes or invent an extra child. Storyboard only; no claim of animated video.
ADDITIONAL CONTINUITY: At S25 show the single spinach bag resting just within the basket rim, Leo's empty hands releasing it. Frame most basket contents below the lower image edge; do not invent visible selected produce. Empty BLUE and YELLOW totes hang flat on a hook. S26 holds two blank colored sheets fully separate. S27 and S28 use identical lens and backdrop: Dan has phone at ANATOMICAL RIGHT ear in S27, and the only phone lies face up on counter in S28. Both colored blank sheets lie flat on counter in these phone panels. Maya and Nina are voices only and never appear. Dan's watch stays anatomical LEFT wrist. Main composition reference is market stall; preserve stripe color and wood structure. Shot labels S25, S26, S27, S28 only. Final image target 2048x1152 landscape.
